method: Four sequential processes in baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order; five warmups and 50 measured calls per fixture and size. Commands identify executable basenames; artifact directories are omitted. Output equality is checked outside the timer.
baselineHarnessRecipe: Copy the committed harness and replace its conduit_markdown package import with baselineHarnessImport. Copy markdown_preprocessor.dart and semantic_details.dart from baselineCommit into sanitizer-baseline beside that harness; compile using the candidate workspace package configuration.
